scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "cross-env MACROBUDDY_SECRET=macrobuddy-dev MACROBUDDY_RELAY_APP_URL= npm run dev -w server" "cross-env MACROBUDDY_SECRET=macrobuddy-dev npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:relay: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "cross-env MACROBUDDY_SECRET=macrobuddy-dev MACROBUDDY_RELAY_APP_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm run dev -w server" "cross-env MACROBUDDY_SECRET=macrobuddy-dev npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit
